In the "Quarter," Heathfield and Freestone were our two runners. Heathfield won his heat in 56.5 secs and although Freestone ran a game race he was unable to get into the placings to enable him to reach the final.
Don Adie (Discus and Long Jump), Alan Fleming (Javelin), Drew (Shot), Allen (Shot and Javelin), Freestone (Discus) and George (Long Jump), are names which come to mind.
With three heats in the 220 Yards, the following qualified for the final, G. Freestone, A.
Freestone won the 440 Yards, and D.
Included on the same programme were two Club Junior Handicaps, and with two heats in the 220 Yards the following qualified for the final : Sexton, A. Fleming, Freestone, Negus, Davis, and E.

Freestone won the 220 Yards and D. Pollard, a son of our former Police sprinter, finished second in the 440.

Betterton and Freestone were first and second in the 440 and Eric Bishop gained third place in the 880 Yards. Arthur Bruce won the 1 Mile, and although the S.L.H. boys won the Relay, we picked up some useful points in the Field Events through the help of Alan Dunn, Dennis Fleming and A.
